{user_content}
""" def create_html_output(input_content: str) -> str: """ Inject user-supplied content into an HTML template after escaping it. Parameters ---------- input_content : str The dynamic content provided by the user. It will be escaped to prevent XSS. Returns ------- str The final HTML string with the escaped user content inserted. """ # Escape special HTML characters to prevent injection attacks. safe_content = html.escape(input_content, quote=True) # Format the template with the escaped content. return html_template.format(user_content=safe_content)
